· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (457.2468→-13087.1262): 악화, 약세 지속

[지지·저항 구조]

[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (1.53배): 최근 움직임에 대한 신뢰도 상승
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간): 매수세 부재로 인한 추가 하락 가능성, 관망 유지 조건
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 1,681,000) vs SMA5 (KRW 1,770,200) / SMA20 (KRW 1,789,600) / SMA50 (KRW 1,678,322): below short/mid-term trends, nearing SMA50
· Position vs SMA100 (KRW 1,938,490) / SMA200 (KRW 1,434,975): weak mid/long-term trend
· 52-week position (49.1%) + current price level at historical midpoint
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (51.2→43.7): entering oversold, maintaining downward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (457.2468→-13087.1262): worsening, continuing bearishness
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band KRW 1,670,335): 13.33% band width indicates sustained volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 1,678,000): aligned with SMA50, risk of breach
· Swing resistance (KRW 1,890,000): potential for short-term bounce if broken
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways): confirming lack of directional bias
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.53x): increased confidence in recent price action
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation): potential for further downside due to lack of buying pressure, maintain wait-and-see stance
